name: Mary
bio: Mary, engaged to Joseph, was found to be pregnant by the Holy Spirit before their marriage. An angel appeared to Joseph explaining this, and he took her as his wife, naming her son Jesus as instructed (Matthew 1:18-25). Her own calling, told from her perspective, and her role throughout Jesus's life, are detailed in the chapters ahead. Wise men from the east found the young Jesus with Mary and worshipped him, presenting gold, frankincense, and myrrh; soon after, Joseph fled with her and Jesus to Egypt to escape Herod's massacre of Bethlehem's children, returning only after Herod's death (Matthew 2:1-23).
